instruction: Add a "fade" slide transition to the second slide of my presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time;  time.sleep(4); pyautogui.doubleClick(x={SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, y={SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);pyautogui.mouseDown(); pyautogui.mouseUp(); time.sleep(0.5);
import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(4.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully added dissolve transition to slide 1 by opening Slide menu > Slide Transition, selecting Dissolve from the panel, and saving the file. Completed in 8 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Impress menus, open Slide Transition panel, select specific transitions, save presentations
metadata.task_rationale: Varies the transition type (fade instead of dissolve) and target slide (slide 2 instead of slide 1) to test same capability with different parameters
metadata.explanation: Task requires adding fade transition to slide 2. Evaluator uses existing check_transition metric which reads slide XML to verify the transition element.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vm_file) correctly fetches the presentation file after postconfig saves it with Ctrl+S
Expected type is 'rule'; get_rule returns {"slide_idx": 1, "transition_type": "fade"} directly to the metric — correct parameter handling
check_transition correctly maps slide_idx=1 to slide2.xml (index+1), targeting the second slide as required
Metric correctly searches for <p:fade> XML element under <p:transition>, which is the OOXML representation of a fade transition
Single-requirement instruction (add fade transition to slide 2) is fully covered by the evaluator
